claude_proposed_widenings.name: passive_modifier (new ClassFeatureMechanics family)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Extra Attack is an always-on rule change with no activation cost, no use-count resource, and no rest reset cadence. The sole existing ClassFeatureMechanics family ('activation') requires all three via ClassFeatureMechanicsHeader. Filling those fields with invented values (e.g., use_count with cap fixed/uses=∞) would be dishonest. A new 'passive_modifier' family is needed for permanent class feature rules that apply automatically with no quota or refresh cycle.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You can attack twice instead of once whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: scale_attack_count (new ClassFeatureEffect variant)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Extra Attack scales the number of attacks produced within a single Attack action, not the action economy. The existing grant_extra_action effect grants an additional Action (as Action Surge does). Using it here would falsely imply the barbarian gains an extra Action rather than an extra attack within one Action. The v4 taxonomy already names scale_attack_count as the correct atom for this mechanic ('The number of attacks per Attack action grows with level. Example: Extra Attack (2→4)'). A ClassFeatureEffect variant is needed to carry it on the surface.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You can attack twice instead of once whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.
